title: Cozy Bytes 🍺 | Rust::Who Owns the Cat? 🐈🦀
why_read: A lighthearted, beginner-friendly explainer of Rust's ownership and borrowing rules using cat jokes, fine for newcomers but offers nothing new to experienced Rust developers.
analysis: This is an informal, humor-driven tutorial covering the absolute basics of Rust's ownership model: moves, borrowing, and mutable references, illustrated with a running cat analogy. It correctly explains the core rules but at a very introductory level with no depth beyond what's in the official Rust book. It may help total beginners build intuition in a fun way, but experienced engineers will find nothing new here.
